in_marathi.name: Jaisal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaisal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaisal derives from the Sanskrit words jaya, meaning 'victory', and isal, meaning 'god'. This name is often given to boys in Hindu culture as a sign of divine favor and protection.

in_bengali.name: Jaisal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Victory of God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jaisal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jaisal derives from the Sanskrit words jaya, meaning 'victory', and isal, meaning 'god'. This name is often given to boys in Hindu culture as a sign of divine favor and protection.
